table.name: TLGNU_USER_SAREA_ACC
table.description: Access Control/Data restriction table. Defines the Sales Area (TLGNC_SAREA) a user has access to.

column.name: SAREA_ID
column.description: FK TLGNC_SAREA. The Sales Area for which access is granted.

column.name: USER_COMPANYCODE_ACC_ID
column.description: FK tlgnu_user_companycode_acc. With this constraint, we enforce that any sales area restriction requires that its company code is also restricted. I.e. you cannot create a sales area restriction, if there is not already a restriction on the respective company code.
